findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-studio" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_catalog, get_catalog_item, search_docs, create_agent_persona · Private data: pano_capture_start, pano_capture_status, pano_scene_create, pano_scene_status, create_agent_persona · Public sink: refine_model, pano_capture_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_catalog, get_catalog_item, search_docs, create_agent_persona · Private data: pano_capture_start, pano_capture_status, pano_scene_create, pano_scene_status, create_agent_persona · Public sink: refine_model, pano_capture_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "text_to_avatar" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
